deliverable.source_excerpt: # SHIRMANI Supreme NLP Operational Hardening This layer turns the existing Supreme NLP contract into a continuously observable, fail-closed operating system. ## Five-minute deterministic loop 1. Validate contract and evaluation schema. 2. Validate governance invariants. 3. Generate operational telemetry. 4. Block on missing artifacts or failed integrity gates. 5. Preserve telemetry as a generated artifact. The loop does not claim model accuracy. Accuracy remains a benchmark property. ## Signal-to-language contract A future instrumented signal record must preserve: Signal → Measurement → Detected Pattern → Model Inference → Plain-Language Interpretation → Confidence → Provenance → Verification → Unknowns. For biological, plant, environmental or non-living signals, the system may describe measured patterns and model inferences. It must not silently convert those patterns into proof of subjective feeling, consciousness or intention. ## Improvement gate An improvement is accepted only when the task, population, dataset fingerprint, metric and evaluation protocol are comparable to a declared baseline and the result is reproducible. ## High-impact boundary Production changes, irreversible actions, financial actions and independent verification remain subject to the existing governance and human-authorization requirements.

꙰ Public Platform Charter — निष्पक्ष समझ

यह platform research, reasoning, creation और livelihood को एक evidence-first public ecosystem में जोड़ता है।

Public identity

शिरोमणि रामपॉल सैनी public creator/researcher identity हैं। “निष्पक्ष समझ”, “शमीकरण यथार्थ सिद्धांत” और “यथार्थ युग” framework/philosophical propositions के रूप में स्पष्ट label होंगे जब तक स्वतंत्र empirical verification उपलब्ध न हो।

Integrity architecture

source → provenance → reasoning → evidence → verification → QC → product/presentation → safety → publication

  • AI agreement independent verification नहीं है।
  • Prepared review packets verified records नहीं हैं।
  • Missing evidence visibly unverified रहेगा।
  • Rejected, deferred, unavailable और changed tasks traceable रहेंगे।
  • Evidence, reviewer, experiment, citation, transaction, customer, revenue या testimonial fabricate नहीं हों

deliverable.source_excerpt: # Supreme NLP — Evidence-First Multimodal Interpretation This layer extends the Research Institute without treating generated interpretations as independent scientific proof. Pipeline: Signal -> normalization -> feature extraction -> modality agreement -> evidence grading -> interpretation -> confidence -> limitations -> audit. ## Design rules - Fail closed when evidence is missing. - Separate observable signals from interpretation. - Never infer subjective experience directly from sensor data. - Keep provenance and fingerprints for every result. - Require independent verification before promotion to VERIFIED. - Keep the core deterministic so optional ML/NLP models can be evaluated behind the same contract. - Scheduled production-code mutation is disabled. The layer is model-agnostic: later ML/NLP models can replace individual functions while preserving this evidence contract.
